description: Three shop maths jobs. sale: price after one or two stacked discounts (each a percent or a fixed amount) plus optional tax/VAT, with what you save and the effective total discount (stacked percents multiply). reverse: the discount % between an old and a new price. compare: which of two deals is cheaper per unit (price and amount of each). Money is rounded to the cent at each step like a till. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/discount-calc/

amountA.description: compare: amount of deal A (e.g. 0.5 for 500 g when unit is kg).

discountType.description: sale: first discount is a percent or a fixed amount.

extraDiscount.description: sale: optional second discount applied after the first.

taxPercent.description: sale: optional tax / VAT percent added after the discounts.

unit.description: compare: the unit name (kg, L, item…). Default "unit".

name: calc_discount
title: Discount / sale price calculator
